item.description: South Tampa’s iconic Wright’s Gourmet House opened a new location on Friday.

item.title: No believed survivors after Venice-based Agape Flights plane crashes in Haiti
item.description: A Sarasota County-based Christian missionary organization lost contact with one of its planes on Thursday afternoon.

item.title: Joint operation leads to largest seizure of illegal vapes in Florida history
item.description: Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier announced the largest seizure of illegal vaping products and contraband on Friday following a joint operation.

item.title: Mother of Venice High School student arrested after daughter brought her gun to school: affidavit
item.description: A mother of a Venice High School student was arrested on Tuesday after her daughter brought her firearm to school, authorities said.

item.title: Florida teen suspected in stepsister's cruise ship death appears in court: report
item.description: A 16-year-old boy under investigation in connection with his stepsister's death on a cruise ship appeared in federal court in Miami on Friday.

item.title: Daughter of Largo man, missing for months, pleads for help
item.description: The daughter of an 87-year-old Largo man who has been missing for months said she understands the pain the Guthrie family is feeling and hopes the attention surrounding Savannah Guthrie’s mother will also help bring renewed focus to her own father’s case.

item.title: West Hernando Pools owner arrested on fraud charge
item.description: The owner of a once-popular pool company at the center of a Better Call Behnken investigation was arrested Thursday.

item.title: Hillsborough judge fights back tears while describing 4-year-old's murder in death sentence hearing
item.description: The man who brutally stabbed his girlfriend and her 4-year-old daughter to death in Dover was sentenced to death on Friday.

item.title: FBI investigating new message in Nancy Guthrie's disappearance
